record_notes.DCP-LETT-1090F: May 25, 1847 replies to missing Allen May 21 note. Declines new undertaking because limited health and existing natural history materials, while doubting ability and acceptance; this is not rejection of educational work in principle. Exact proposed project unknown, education of poor children editorial conjecture from broad aspiration. John Allen recipient, not JS as summary states. Final wrong-way-first note was on first sheet verso while body continues on second torn sheet; preserve original wording and source order without confusing it for a new letter or agent instruction.
